{{Item infobox | rarity = fine | type = consumable | icon = Box of Fun.png | description = Double-click to create a box full of random goofs and gags! Lasts 15 minutes. | bound = account | id = 20000 }} [[Box o' Fun]] is a magical chest that contains many random effects to entertain the masses. Wherever you use the box an {{map icon|activity}} [[activity]] symbol will appear on the [[map]] so that other players will notice the box. It can be obtained from various sources and gives the player 10 times a random skill bar or transformation. [[File:Box o' Fun.jpg|240px|thumb|Box o' Fun]] == Acquisition == === Sold by === {{Sold by}} === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Other === * This item was available during the [[Secrets of the Obscure]] [[Twitch Drops]] campaign from '''August 22, 2023''', to '''August 28, 2023'''. {{Mail | icon = ArenaNet | sender = ArenaNet | subject = Special Item Delivery | content = Enjoy your prize! | nosign = y | reward = {{item icon|Box o' Fun}} }} == Randomizer settings == To change the settings of their Box o' Fun, the owner can interact twice with the box to receive an adjuster, which looks like a [[Cavalier Hammer]] and has two skills. {| {{STDT}} {{Environmental skill table header}} {{Environmental skill table row|Reset the randomizer.}} {{Environmental skill table row|Adjust Box of Fun}} |} ;Using the [[Adjust Box of Fun]] skill, hits the Box with the adjuster and gives you the following dialogue:
:The randomizer can be adjusted to a number of settings. Choose a setting. :{{dialogue icon|yes}} ''Set it to only change colors.'' :{{dialogue icon|yes}} ''Set it to celebration mode.'' :{{dialogue icon|yes}} ''Set it to only transform appearances.'' :{{dialogue icon|more}} ''Attempt a more advanced modification.'' ::The randomizer can be adjusted to a number of settings. Choose a setting.'' ::{{dialogue icon|yes}} ''Set it to petrify mode.'' ::{{dialogue icon|yes}} ''Set it to travel-toy mode.'' ::{{dialogue icon|back}} ''Keep the standard settings.'' ::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Reset the randomizer.'' ::{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Leave it alone.'' :{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Leave it alone.''
Selecting a dialog option will switch the box to the selected mode for 2 minutes. After 2 minutes have passed, the box will close and provide the opportunity for a random mode when re-opened (unless the owner uses [[Adjust Box of Fun]] to assign the box mode once more). == Possible Effects == An icon will appear over the Box o' Fun indicating which effect it will cause when interacted with. === Change Colors === [[File:Color Change (Box o' Fun overhead icon).png|right|The transformation icon displayed over the box.]] * The player becomes transparent ([[Stealth]]) * The player shifts colors (from yellow to red, then green) * The player becomes red, blue, purple, yellow or orange. === Transform Appearances === [[File:Transformations (Box o' Fun overhead icon).png|right|The transformation icon displayed over the box.]] The player gets transformed and is able to participate in [[Costume Brawl]]. Possible transformations are: * a [[Skritt]] * a [[Pig]] * a [[Blue Ooze]] * a [[Brimstone Imp]] * a [[Golem]] * a [[Sylvan Hound]] * a [[Pink Moa]] * a [[Stag]] * a [[Veteran Corrupted Ice Elemental|Corrupted Ice Elemental]] * a giant version of him/herself === Celebration Mode === * Explosion (Knocks back players nearby the Box) * Snowball (Knocks down struck player) * [[Snowball Fighter]] - Alters the skill bar to possess only a single skill. Throw a snowball at a fellow player (causes a 1 second knockdown from a max range of 800) [[File:Fireworks (Box o' Fun overhead icon).png|right|The transformation icon displayed over the box.]] * Fireworks - Alters the skill bar to possess three skills for shooting fireworks which can each be used three times, with a shorter cooldown than normal [[fireworks]]. :{| {{STDT}} {{Environmental skill table header}} {{Environmental skill table row|Blue Fireworks (Box o' Fun)}} {{Environmental skill table row|Green Fireworks (Box o' Fun)}} {{Environmental skill table row|Red Fireworks (Box o' Fun)}} |} * {{effect|Dancing Spirit}} - The player can perform various dances. :{| {{STDT}} {{Environmental skill table header}} {{Environmental skill table row|Stop Dancing}} {{Environmental skill table row|Dodge Step}} {{Environmental skill table row|Inventory Shuffle}} {{Environmental skill table row|Gear Grind}} |} * A giant version of him/herself === Petrify Mode === [[File:Petrified (Box o' Fun overhead icon).png|right|The transformation icon displayed over the box.]] * [[Petrified]] - After a short countdown, the player will become petrified, taking on a stone appearance and being unable to move. The effect lasts indefinitely, but the player may {{skill icon|Walk It Off}} whenever they choose. === Travel Toy Mode === Interacting with the Box o' Fun will show you the following dialogue:
:This box appears to be full of temporary [[Travel Toy|travel toys]]. :{{dialogue icon|choice}} ''Try a [[Riding Broom]].'' :{{dialogue icon|choice}} ''Try a [[Magic Carpet]].'' :{{dialogue icon|choice}} ''Try a [[Sonic Tunneling Tool]].'' :{{dialogue icon|choice}} ''Try an [[Electromagnetic Ascender]].'' :{{dialogue icon|end}} ''Leave it alone.''
Choosing a travel toy will give you 15 minutes of {{effect|Temporary Travel Toy}} and 3 hours of the corresponding automatic effect. == Used in == {{recipe list}} == Notes == * The Gem Store description is as follows: "Spawn a box full of random fun for everyone in the area. Every 15 seconds, the box generates a new amusing option. Color-changing, shape-shifting, and other tricks can be yours! Each box remains in the world for 15 minutes." * Despite the Gem Store description, if the owner of the box uses [[Adjust Box of Fun]] to assign the box mode, it will remain in that mode for 2 minutes. The box will only maintain the potential for 15 second cycles if it has not been assigned using [[Adjust Box of Fun]] or has since closed after being assigned for 2 or more minutes. == Gem Store history == {{Gem Store history table header}} {{Gem Store history table row|2012-08-28|2013-01-27}} * New {{Gem Store history table row|2013-01-28|live}} * Price permanently reduced * 1/{{gem|80}}; 5/{{gem|320}} {{Gem Store history table row|2013-03-21|2013-03-21|15%}} * [[Gem Store/March Sale#March Sale, 2013|March Sale (2013)]] {{Gem Store history table row|2014-03-24|2014-03-24|50%}} * [[Gem Store/March Sale#March Sale, 2014|March Sale (2014)]] {{Gem Store history table row|2016-02-26|unknown}} * 1 Free {{Gem Store history table row|2018-03-31|2018-04-01|60%}} * [[Gem Store/March Sale#March Sale, 2018|March Sale (2018)]] * [[Gem Store/Super Adventure Festival#Super Adventure Festival (2018)|Super Adventure Festival (2018)]] {{Gem Store history table row|2024-12-17|2024-12-31|20%}} * [[Gem Store/Wintersday#Wintersday: A Very Merry Wintersday (2024)|Wintersday (2024)]] {{Gem Store history table row|2025-03-11|2025-03-18|25%}} * [[Gem Store/March Sale#March Sale, 2025|March Sales (2025)]] {{Gem Store history table row|2026-03-03|2026-03-10|25%}} * [[Gem Store/March Sale#March Sale, 2026|March Sales (2026)]] |} [[Category:Giftable items]] [[Category:Gem Store]] [[Category:Costume Brawl]] [[de:Kiste voll Spaß]] [[es:Caja de diversión]] [[fr:Boîte à malices]]
